==Wanderer and Watcher==
I honestly don't recall these names ever being given to Morridin in the books, and don't really understand their significance. Anyone know where they're from? [[User:Rahien|<font color="#0099CC">'''Rahien'''</font>]] 19:25, December 25, 2009 (UTC)
:Working from memory, the Watcher refers to the guy in fancloth that was watching Graendal and Sammael when they were meeting with Sevanna and she used the call box. The Wanderer refers to the guy that is wandering around Shaidar Logoth when Rand and he crossed the beams. Both are fan-made names derived from the activities of Mr. Nae'blis before we, as readers, knew that he was Moridin. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 16:24, December 27, 2009 (UTC)
